title: Tangerine Sherbet
changes_from_base: Tangerine juice and zest replace the orange and lemon; the cream goes straight into the machine unwhipped and corn syrup replaces the setting agent of the source.
summary: Sweet tangerine juice and zest churned with a little cold cream into a soft, creamy, pastel sherbet.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Zest
steps.text: Finely grate the zest of two tangerines into the small pan.

steps.title: Juice
steps.text: Squeeze all the tangerines, picking out the pips, to make about 360 ml.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Add the juice, sugar, corn syrup and salt to the zest and warm just to body temperature, stirring, until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Refrigerate until cold, at least 2 h, then strain out the zest.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Pour the juice into the machine with the cold cream and churn for 20-25 min until creamy.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for 1 h before serving; small spoons make it last longer.

tips: Strain the zest out after chilling so the flavour has time to develop.
Satsumas or mandarins can be used instead of tangerines.
You might want to make double; it goes quickly.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper on the surface in the freezer for up to 1 week. Soften for 5-10 min before scooping.
